selection_rule: Decided before any agent run: (1) highest mean grounded answer on dev answerable questions, (2) then abstention correct on dev unanswerable, (3) then fewer false abstentions, (4) then lower median latency/cost. Test is run only after the choice is frozen.

configs.name: A1-dense-k3
configs.hypothesis: Baseline: Day 6 dense retriever, one or more model-written queries.

configs.name: A2-hybrid-k3
configs.hypothesis: BM25 adds exact-wording matches (e.g. 'local spies', 'fox and lion') that dense misses.

configs.name: A3-rerank-k5
configs.hypothesis: Best retrieval config on dev (rerank k5: context 11/16); more evidence in context should raise grounded answers at higher latency/tokens.

configs.name: A4-dense-k3-v2
configs.hypothesis: Improvement 1 (dev error 1, q10/q13/q14): v1 answers omitted inline [id] markers and were rejected; v2 prompt enforces inline citations and diversified re-queries. Same retriever as A1 to isolate the prompt effect.

configs.name: A5-rerank-k5-v2
configs.hypothesis: Improvement 2 (dev error 2, q11/q15/q16): rewritten queries + rerank, and a larger budget so chunks from the 2nd/3rd search still fit in the cumulative context.

configs.name: A6-rerank-k5-v3
configs.hypothesis: Fix found while reading A5 dev traces (q09, q16): queries that contain the author name retrieve the same commentary chunks; v3 forbids author/book names in queries (filters stay user-supplied).
